                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 3/23/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Waguespack (32)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 7-1 at 2420 N Sacramento
                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                     ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe C2-2,
Motor Vehicle Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 7-1 In the area bound by;

      North Linden Place; North Sacramento Avenue; and a northwesteriy line starting from a
      point 76.5 feet south of North Linden Place as measured along the west line of North
      Sacrament Avenue to a point 92 feet west of North Sacrament Avenue as measured
      along the south line of North Linden Avenue,

to those of a POS-2, Parks and Open Space District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                        Scott Waguespack

                                                        Alderman, 32""^ Ward




Common Address:
2420 N. Sacramento
